title: Bárbara Lennie and Carmen Machi to Star in 'Brutal', Albert Pintó’s New Thriller
summary: Netflix has today announced Brutal, its new film starring Bárbara Lennie (God’s Crooked Lines, Bitter Christmas) and Carmen Machi (Honeymoon with My Mother, Celeste), directed by Albert Pintó (Money Heist, Barren Land).

Netflix has today announced


Brutal


, its new film starring


Bárbara Lennie


(


God’s Crooked Lines, Bitter Christmas


) and


Carmen Machi


(


Honeymoon with My Mother, Celeste


), directed by


Albert


Pintó


(


Money Heist, Barren Land


). Filming of the new thriller is currently underway in Madrid.


Brutal


is produced by


MOD Producciones


and will premiere globally on Netflix. The film is written by


Jordi Vallejo


, produced by


Fernando Bovaira


, with


Urko Errazquin


and


Albert Pintó


serving as executive producers, and cinematography by


Xavi Giménez


.


In 1999, six minors murdered a young boy and were never punished for their crime. 24 years later, a murder as brutal as inexplicable brings Inspector Álex Lazkano (Bárbara Lennie) to uncover a past that many would rather keep buried. Her investigation leads her to Ágata (Carmen Machi), a seemingly warm and kindly woman whose calm appearance may conceal something far darker on the inside. How long can the truth remain hidden? And how far would you go to make sure it never comes to light?


The cast of this intense thriller also includes


Tristán Ulloa


(


A Widow's Game, The Asunta Case


),


Marta Nieto


(


Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine


,


La mitad de Ana


),


Luis Callejo


(


The Fury of a Patient Man


,


Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine


),


Javier Godino


(


Better Class


,


The Secret in Their Eyes


) and


Javier Beltrán


(


God's Crooked Lines, The Innocent


), among others.


About MOD Producciones


MOD is a film and television production company founded in 2007 by Fernando Bovaira, with the aim of combining the highest quality content with box office success. The company launched its production slate with films such as


Agora


, directed by Alejandro Amenábar – which premiered at the Cannes Film Festival and became the highest-grossing film of the year – and


Biutiful


, directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu – which won the Best Actor Award at Cannes and was nominated for the Academy Award® for Best Foreign Language Film. More recently, in 2025, the company released


La buena letra


, an adaptation of Rafael Chirbes’ novel of the same name, directed by Celia Rico, and


The Captive


, Alejandro Amenábar’s latest film. Its most recent releases in 2026 include


La fiera


, directed by Salvador Calvo;


Calle Málaga


, directed by Maryam Touzani;


El último mono


, the latest comedy from Joaquín Mazón Lacasa; and the Netflix miniseries


The Final Problem


, based on the novel by Arturo Pérez-Reverte. Upcoming theatrical releases include


El mal padre


, directed by Roberto Bueso, selected for the Official Selection at the San Sebastián International Film Festival and starring Eduard Fernández; and


Bunker


, an international co-production directed by Florian Zeller, which premiered at the Venice Film Festival and stars Javier Bardem and Penélope Cruz.
